articles.title: IAAPA Expo 2026 Sets Record as Largest Ever, Expands to Two Convention Center Buildings
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo 2026 made history as the largest gathering in the association's history, spanning a record 630,000 square feet across two buildings at the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando. The expanded footprint reflects the continued growth and investment momentum across the global attractions industry. FEC operators and suppliers attending this year's show have more exhibitors and product reveals to explore than ever before.

articles.title: Kalahari Resorts Opens $900M Virginia Location with 90,000-Sq-Ft Adventure Park
articles.summary: Kalahari Resorts & Conventions opened its fifth resort in Spotsylvania, Virginia on November 12, 2026, featuring a 175,000-square-foot indoor waterpark and a 90,000-square-foot adventure park alongside 907 guest rooms and 150,000 square feet of convention space. The $900 million project, supplied in part by Rides 4 U, sets a new benchmark for large-scale indoor entertainment destination resorts. FEC operators should take note of the integrated resort model as a growing competitive format.

articles.title: Topgolf Cuts US Prices by 20%+ Permanently After Guest Feedback Cites Cost as Barrier
articles.summary: Topgolf has permanently reduced gameplay prices across all 100+ US locations by more than 20 percent on average, responding directly to guest surveys identifying high cost as the top reason for infrequent return visits. The move signals a broader reckoning for premium entertainment venues where price-to-value perception is increasingly critical to repeat business. FEC operators should evaluate their own pricing strategies against guest feedback as affordability becomes a key driver of loyalty.

articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Posts $302.6M in Q3 2026 Revenue with Continued Net Loss
articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $302.64 million but recorded a loss per share of $0.21, highlighting the ongoing margin pressure facing large-scale FEC and bowling-entertainment operators. The results offer a financial benchmark for the broader eatertainment sector as operators balance capital investment with profitability. Investors and operators in the bowling and social entertainment space should monitor Lucky Strike's trajectory closely.

articles.title: accesso Signs Seven-Year Technology Partnership with Premier Parks Covering 75+ Properties
articles.summary: accesso Technology Group has entered a seven-year strategic partnership with Premier Parks, North America's second-largest independent attractions operator, to unify ticketing, admissions, food, beverage, and retail systems across its portfolio. The deal demonstrates the growing trend of multi-property operators consolidating guest-experience technology under a single platform provider. FEC operators with multi-site footprints should consider how integrated tech stacks can streamline operations and generate actionable guest data.

articles.title: Six Flags Magic Mountain Unveils Hovercycle Ride Vehicle for Industry-First Thrill Glider Coaster
articles.summary: Six Flags Magic Mountain revealed the ride vehicle for Thrill Glider at IAAPA Expo 2026, showcasing an innovative hovercycle-style train for what will be the world's first Thrillglider roller coaster when it opens in 2027. The attraction was developed exclusively for Magic Mountain by Vekoma, combining flying, motorbike, and suspended coaster technologies. The reveal highlights the competitive arms race among regional parks to introduce genuinely novel ride formats.

articles.title: Slick City Action Park Announces New San Antonio Location
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park, the indoor slide park concept, is expanding with a new location in San Antonio, Texas. The brand's continued growth reflects strong consumer demand for active, slide-based indoor entertainment formats. FEC operators should watch Slick City as a fast-scaling competitor in the family indoor entertainment space.

articles.title: Kentucky Kingdom Reveals Car for World's Largest Indoor Wooden Coaster, Opening Spring 2027
articles.summary: Kentucky Kingdom and The Gravity Group unveiled the front car of Midnight Showdown, billed as the world's largest indoor wooden roller coaster, at IAAPA Expo 2026. The horse racing-themed attraction is set to open in spring 2027 and represents a significant capital investment in indoor thrill attractions. The project underscores growing interest in large-format indoor rides as a way to extend seasonal operations.

articles.title: Holiday World Completes Track for Cannonball! Water Roller Coaster, Unveils Watermelon Boat
articles.summary: Holiday World & Splashin' Safari announced track completion and unveiled the custom watermelon-themed boat for Cannonball!, its upcoming water roller coaster, at IAAPA Expo 2026. The attraction is generating significant buzz as a new hybrid water-coaster format for family parks. Operators planning waterpark expansions should track Cannonball! as a case study in differentiated, high-profile capital investments.

articles.title: Mattel City at VAI Resort Expands from 9 to 14 Acres with 35 IP-Driven Experiences
articles.summary: VAI Resort has rebranded its Arizona theme park project as Mattel City, expanding the concept from 9 to 14 acres with 35 experiences based on Mattel brands including Barbie, Monster High, and Hot Wheels. Falcon's Beyond is serving as lead creative designer for the project, which represents a major multi-billion-dollar destination investment. The expansion signals continued confidence in IP-driven indoor and outdoor entertainment destinations as a development model.

articles.title: Betson Named Exclusive North American Distributor for Bay Tek's Connect 4: Four in a Roll Arcade Game
articles.summary: Betson Enterprises has secured exclusive North American distribution rights for Connect 4: Four in a Roll, a new alley roller arcade game from Bay Tek Entertainment debuting at IAAPA Expo 2026. The game leverages the instantly recognizable Connect 4 brand to lower the barrier to play and drive repeat token spend. FEC operators looking to refresh arcade floors with proven IP-branded redemption games should put this title on their radar.

articles.title: Former Supermarket in Fort Wayne to Be Converted into Indoor Slide Park
articles.summary: A former Marsh supermarket building in Fort Wayne, Indiana is being repurposed as an indoor slide park, illustrating the ongoing trend of converting large retail vacancies into active entertainment venues. This adaptive reuse approach is increasingly popular among FEC developers seeking affordable real estate in established traffic corridors. Operators and investors should note the strong pipeline of available retail boxes as potential low-cost FEC development sites.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Center Opens New Location in Denton, Texas
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment Center has opened a new venue in Denton, Texas, continuing the brand's regional expansion in the competitive DFW market. The opening adds to the growing density of trampoline and active-entertainment parks in suburban Texas markets. Local operators should monitor market saturation dynamics as national FEC chains increase their Texas footprints.

articles.title: Intamin and Lagoon Unveil J3 Grand Prix Multi-Launch Coaster Train at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Intamin and Lagoon revealed the ride car for J3 Grand Prix, a Hot Racer coaster that will be the Utah park's first multi-launch coaster and its first Intamin installation. The attraction features two launches via friction wheel technology, three inversions, and 12 airtime moments. The reveal at IAAPA highlights the continued investment regional parks are making in headline coaster attractions to drive visitation.

articles.title: Dutch Wonderland Nearly Doubles Water Play Area with Kingdom Cove Expansion Opening Summer 2027
articles.summary: Dutch Wonderland in Lancaster, Pennsylvania will nearly double its water play footprint with the Kingdom Cove Water Play Zone, adding three new water slides to the existing Duke's Lagoon area. The expansion represents the park's largest-ever water play investment and is designed to deepen family appeal during the summer season. Regional FEC and park operators planning water play additions can look to this project as a model for staged, family-focused expansion.

articles.title: Disney Parks and Cruises Hit All-Time Attendance and Revenue Records in Fiscal 2026
articles.summary: Disney's experiences segment reported record global attendance, with a 4 percent year-over-year increase in guests and a 15 percent jump in quarterly revenue to $10.1 billion. Full-year operating income for the segment grew significantly, reinforcing the resilience of premium, IP-driven destination entertainment. For FEC operators and investors, Disney's results affirm that quality guest experiences continue to command premium spending even in a challenging consumer environment.

articles.title: Cosm and Disney Partner to Screen Star Wars in Immersive Shared Reality Dome Format
articles.summary: Cosm has announced a multi-year partnership with Disney to present Star Wars films in its Shared Reality dome format, starting with A New Hope in March 2027 to mark the franchise's 50th anniversary. The 12K+ LED dome experience wraps audiences in dynamic visuals beyond the central screen, creating a new category of premium cinema-entertainment. Location-based entertainment operators should watch Cosm's expansion as an indicator of where immersive group viewing experiences are heading.

articles.title: UK's First Human Claw Machine Opens in Leicester as Indoor Entertainment Cluster Grows
articles.summary: Leicester has launched the UK's first human claw machine experience, part of a broader clustering of indoor entertainment venues making the city centre a destination for novel attractions. The concept gamifies the classic claw machine format at human scale, offering a shareable, social-media-friendly experience. FEC operators should watch novelty participatory concepts like this as low-capex additions that drive social sharing and walk-in traffic.

articles.title: Madison County Approves $11.7M in TIF Borrowing for Retail and Entertainment Development
articles.summary: Madison County, Mississippi has approved up to $11.741 million in tax increment financing borrowing to support The Gallery, a mixed-use development expected to include dining and entertainment components. TIF financing is an increasingly important tool for FEC developers seeking to anchor community-driven retail entertainment projects. Operators and developers should monitor municipal TIF programs as a viable pathway to subsidized entertainment development.

articles.title: Adventureland Iowa Adds Twisted Tiki Five-Story Family Raft Slide for Summer 2027
articles.summary: Adventureland in Altoona, Iowa has announced Twisted Tiki, a five-story family raft slide and the park's first-ever family raft slide format, opening at Adventure Bay in summer 2027. The addition continues a pattern of regional parks investing in multi-generational water attractions to broaden appeal and extend visit duration. Waterpark and FEC operators can look to this as an example of affordable capacity-building in the water play category.

articles.title: TEA Announces 2027 Thea Award Recipients at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: The Themed Entertainment Association announced the recipients of its 33rd Annual Thea Awards at IAAPA Expo 2026, with the gala scheduled for April 3, 2027 as part of TEA INSPIRE. The Thea Awards are the industry's most recognized benchmark for excellence in attraction design and storytelling. FEC operators and designers should review the winning projects for creative and operational best practices to benchmark against.

articles.title: Omaha Property at 3002 Dodge Street Being Considered for Indoor Entertainment Venue Conversion
articles.summary: A commercial property at 3002 Dodge Street in Omaha, Nebraska may be repurposed as an indoor entertainment venue, according to local reports. The potential conversion is consistent with a national trend of adaptive reuse of underutilized commercial real estate for entertainment purposes. FEC developers scouting Midwest markets should track this Omaha development as an indicator of local demand and real estate opportunity.

articles.title: Six Flags Appoints Adam Boal as Chief Procurement Officer
articles.summary: Six Flags has named Adam Boal as its new Chief Procurement Officer, bringing experience overseeing billions in corporate spend and managing supplier partnerships. The hire signals the company's focus on supply chain efficiency and vendor management as it integrates its expanded post-merger portfolio. Suppliers to major FEC and theme park chains should be aware of potential shifts in procurement strategy and vendor relationships under new leadership.

articles.title: WhiteWater Appoints Michael Dalzell as VP of Global Marketing
articles.summary: WhiteWater, a leading waterpark ride and attraction manufacturer, has named Michael Dalzell as Vice President of Global Marketing, bringing over two decades of experience in brand building and customer experience. The appointment reflects continued investment by major suppliers in strengthening their global commercial presence. FEC and waterpark operators working with WhiteWater may see updated go-to-market strategies and product positioning from the company in the near term.

articles.title: Four Lake Houston-Area Entertainment Venues Share Operational Updates
articles.summary: Four entertainment venues in the Lake Houston area have shared updates on their current operations, offerings, and upcoming changes, reflecting the active competitive landscape in Houston-area suburban entertainment. Local market activity reports like this provide useful intelligence for operators assessing regional saturation and consumer demand. FEC operators in growing suburban markets should monitor local venue developments to stay ahead of competitive shifts.

articles.title: Netflix House Struggling to Draw Nighttime Visitors, Reports Bloomberg
articles.summary: Bloomberg reports that Netflix House, the entertainment destination brand launched by the streaming giant, is facing challenges attracting guests during evening hours despite strong IP recognition. The finding raises questions about the viability of brand-driven location-based entertainment without a compelling food, beverage, or social nighttime hook. FEC operators developing premium immersive venues should factor daypart programming and evening engagement strategies into their concept design.

articles.title: New Multi-Activity Indoor Entertainment Venue Coming to Amble, Northumberland
articles.summary: A new indoor entertainment venue offering a range of activities is set to open in Amble, Northumberland, adding to the growing number of multi-activity FEC-style venues launching in smaller UK towns. The trend reflects broadening geographic demand for accessible indoor entertainment beyond major urban centres. Operators and investors looking at secondary market opportunities should note the appetite for FEC concepts in underserved smaller communities.

articles.title: LEGOLAND Florida to Open Interactive Master Model Builder Studio in Early 2027
articles.summary: LEGOLAND Florida Resort is adding a Master Model Builder Studio near MINILAND USA in early 2027, giving guests a behind-the-scenes look at how iconic LEGO models are constructed. The interactive space invites families to observe skilled builders at work, adding an educational and participatory layer to the park experience. FEC operators can draw lessons from this concept as an example of experience enrichment that deepens dwell time without major capital outlay.
